$Comment: Frost beam bolt from the LEFT hand (2026-10-21: the burst alternates right/left throws). Same bolt as Projectile_Config_AT_Ice_King_Frost_Beam (Parent), only the spawn point mirrored to his left hand (X -0.45). 2026-10-21 (playtest: some bolts went into the ground in front of a short target): SpawnOffset Y is 0. HeadMotionAim corrects its aim for the spawn point with ProjectileComponent.computeStartOffset, which subtracts SpawnOffset.Y (it takes +Y as DOWN), while the spawn itself (ProjectileConfig.getCalculatedOffset) adds it (+Y = up). With Y -0.45 (hand height) the aim thought the bolt left 0.45 ABOVE the eyes while it left 0.45 BELOW, so it flew about 0.9 below the aim line. Only Y 0 agrees on both sides; X (side) agrees, so the hand side stays. 2026-10-21: X ±0.2 (was ±0.45). The burst roots have no AimingReference, so the aim makes no side correction and every bolt flies parallel to the aim line, X blocks to the side; at 0.45 a bolt could pass beside a thin target (a player is 0.65 wide).
